name: Critter Park
summary:
Frogs, clouds, bread slices, moles and raccoons all want a good day out, and you run the park.

Sell tickets at the booth, seat guests on the carousel, teacups and Ferris wheel, then pull the start lever once enough of them have boarded, and the unload lever when the ride stops. Snacks are cooked by hand. Waiting costs money, so hire a cleaner and a ticket clerk and level them up as they keep pace with you. Each day is four minutes of park time; at closing you see every coin in and out, then spend your profit on new rides, benches and flower beds.
